## Fig 1C UMAP NSCLC

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r umap, echo=FALSE}
## load in data
nsclc <- readRDS("~/R/nsclc.rds")


DimPlot(nsclc, 
        group.by = "All.Subsets", label = F,
        cols = All.Subsets.Col, 
        raster = F) + 
  NoAxes()

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.


## Fig 1D Canonical markers dotplot
```{r dotplot, echo=FALSE}
Idents(nsclc) <- nsclc$All.Subsets
canon_markers <- c(
# CD8
'CD3D', 'CD3E',
'CD8A', 'CD8B',
#'IFI6',
# CD4
'CD4', 'FOXP3', 'CXCL13',
# B cell
 'IGHG4', 'IGHG1', 'MZB1', 'CD79A','CD19',
# NK cell
'FCGR3A', 'KLRD1', 'NKG7', 'XCL1',
#ILC
'RORC', 'IL23R', 'KIT',
# Mast Cell
'GATA2','IL1RL1',
# Monocyte
'CD14', 'FCN1', 'S100A8', 'CX3CR1',
# cDCs
 'CLEC10A', 'CD1C','XCR1', 'CLEC9A', 'LAMP3', 'FCER1G',
# macrophage
'APOE', 'C1QB', 'APOC1', 'SPP1', 'LYZ',
#pDC
'CLEC4C', 'JCHAIN', 'PLD4',
# stromal
'MGP', 'LUM',
# proliferating
'MKI67', 'STMN1'
)

nsclc <- ScaleData(nsclc, features = canon_markers)

DotPlot(nsclc, features = rev(as.character(canon_markers)),
        assay = "RNA", cols="RdBu") + coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), axis.text.x = element_text(size=6, angle=90, hjust=1)) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.1,3)) +
  xlab('Gene') +  ylab('Cluster') + 
  ggtitle("Canonical Markers")

```



## Fig 1E barplots TDLN vs tumor
```{r barplots, echo=FALSE}

md <- nsclc@meta.data
cell_count <- unique(md$patient_true) %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    md %>%
      filter(patient_true == p) %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue, All.Subsets) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      group_by(patient_true, tissue) %>%
      mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
      ungroup()
  })


# make a stacked bar chart of the frequency per patient tissue
ggplot(cell_count, aes(x = patient_true, y = percentage, fill = All.Subsets)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = All.Subsets.Col) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of cluster frequency per patient and tissue type",
    x = "Patient ID",
    y = "Cells (%)",
    fill = "Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1))


```

## Fig 1G - CD4/CD8 ratios

```{r}
# see graphpad and illustrator
metadata <- nsclc@meta.data

CD8 <- metadata %>%
  filter(All.Subsets == "CD8 T")
t1 <- as.data.frame(table(CD8$patient_true, CD8$tissue))
colnames(t1) <- c("patient", "tissue", "CD8")
t1$patient_tissue <- paste(t1$patient, t1$tissue, sep = "_")

CD4 <- metadata %>%
  filter(All.Subsets == "CD4 T" |
           All.Subsets == "CD4 Treg" |
           All.Subsets == "CD4 Tfh-like")
t2 <- as.data.frame(table(CD4$patient_true, CD4$tissue))
colnames(t2) <- c("patient", "tissue", "CD4")
t2$patient_tissue <- paste(t2$patient, t2$tissue, sep = "_")

CD4Treg <- metadata %>%
  filter(All.Subsets == "CD4 Treg")
t3 <- as.data.frame(table(CD4Treg$patient_true, CD4Treg$tissue))
colnames(t3) <- c("patient", "tissue", "CD4Treg")
t3$patient_tissue <- paste(t3$patient, t3$tissue, sep = "_")



## create a dataframe with CD8, CD4 and CD4Treg
dfs <- list(t1, t2, t3)
merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "patient_tissue"), dfs)
selected_df <- merged_df %>%
  select(patient_tissue, patient, tissue, CD8, CD4, CD4Treg)

## add CD8/Treg ratio
selected_df$CD8Tregratio <- selected_df$CD8/selected_df$CD4Treg


# select only CD8Tregratio
new_df <- selected_df %>%
  select(patient, tissue, CD8Tregratio)
new_df

# pivot wide table with LN vs tumor
df_wide <- new_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = patient,
    names_from  = tissue,
    values_from = CD8Tregratio
  )

write.csv(df_wide, 'nsclc.CD8Tregratio.csv')
## graphpad for figure

```


## Fig 1G2 - DC ratio in TDLN vs tumor
```{r}
DC <- metadata %>%
  filter(All.Subsets == "cDC1"|
           All.Subsets == "cDC2" |
           All.Subsets == "moDC" |
           All.Subsets == "migDC")
t1 <- as.data.frame(table(DC$patient_true, DC$tissue))
colnames(t1) <- c("patient", "tissue", "DC")
t1$patient_tissue <- paste(t1$patient, t1$tissue, sep = "_")

mac <- metadata %>%
  filter(All.Subsets == "Macrophage APOE" |
        All.Subsets == "Macrophage LYZ")
t2 <- as.data.frame(table(mac$patient_true, mac$tissue))
colnames(t2) <- c("patient", "tissue", "mac")
t2$patient_tissue <- paste(t2$patient, t2$tissue, sep = "_")




## create a dataframe with CD8, CD4 and CD4Treg
dfs <- list(t1, t2)
merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "patient_tissue"), dfs)
selected_df <- merged_df %>%
  select(patient_tissue, patient.x, tissue.x, DC, mac)

## add CD8/Treg ratio
selected_df$DCmacratio <- selected_df$DC/selected_df$mac


# select only CD8Tregratio
new_df <- selected_df %>%
  select(patient.x, tissue.x, DCmacratio)
colnames(new_df) <- c('patient', 'tissue', 'DCmacratio')

# pivot wide table with LN vs tumor
df_wide <- new_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = patient,
    names_from  = tissue,
    values_from = DCmacratio
  )

write.csv(df_wide, 'nsclc.DCmacratio.csv')
```
